title: Methods scammers use
summary_en: Scammers commonly combine impersonation, urgency, and emotional pressure. Official-looking branding or caller information does not prove a message is genuine.
summary_zh: 诈骗者常把冒充身份、制造紧迫感和情绪压力结合使用。看似官方的品牌标识或来电信息并不能证明内容真实。

title: Types of scams
summary_en: Scam messages can imitate government, businesses, friends, or family. Phishing attempts try to obtain bank details, passwords, card numbers, or other personal information.
summary_zh: 诈骗信息可能冒充政府、企业、朋友或家人。网络钓鱼通常试图获取银行资料、密码、银行卡号或其他个人信息。

title: Spotting scams
publisher: Australian Signals Directorate's Australian Cyber Security Centre
summary_en: Do not provide details through a link in an unexpected message. Open the organisation's official website yourself and use independently sourced contact details.
summary_zh: 不要通过意外信息中的链接提交资料。应自行打开机构官方网站，并使用独立找到的联系方式进行核实。

title: Report and recover from scams
publisher: Australian Signals Directorate's Australian Cyber Security Centre
summary_en: If money was sent, contact the financial institution immediately. Stop communicating with the offender, preserve key details, and report the incident through the appropriate official channel.
summary_zh: 如果已经转账，应立即联系金融机构。停止与对方沟通，保存事件关键信息，并通过适当的官方渠道报告。

title: False alarm, real scam: impersonation scams targeting older adults
summary_en: Impersonation scams often invent an urgent account, crime, or computer-security problem and demand that money be moved to keep it safe. Verify using a number or website you already know is real.
summary_zh: 冒充诈骗经常虚构账户、犯罪或电脑安全紧急情况，并要求转移资金来“保障安全”。请使用你独立确认的真实号码或网站核实。

title: Guiding principles to help older adults spot fraud
summary_en: Three recurring warning signs are unexpected contact, pressure to act quickly, and a demand to pay in a specific hard-to-reverse way. Slow down and check the story independently.
summary_zh: 三个常见警告信号是：意外联系、催促立刻行动，以及要求使用难以追回的特定付款方式。先停下来，独立核实对方说法。

title: Elder Fraud
summary_en: Older adults are targeted through tech-support, family-emergency, investment, and other online fraud schemes. Official reporting pages provide current alerts and recovery contacts.
summary_zh: 老年人可能成为技术支持、家庭紧急情况、投资等网络诈骗的目标。官方报告页面提供最新警示和补救联系方式。
